'''"One of the Thousand" Cult Membership''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in [[The Black Goat of the Woods]] expansion.

==Card info==
Whenever you have an encounter in the [[Black Cave]], the [[Unvisited Isle]], or the [[Woods]], instead draw a card from the [[Cult Encounter]]s deck.
